reason: Free listing with the flyers loaded for me, sure, that costs me nothing. But I'm not paying anyone until I see real numbers: 500 people on a waitlist isn't customers walking into my bar.
objection: 500 signups is not people actually going out in my town. I've paid for boosts before and never got real numbers, so I'll believe it when I see the active users and my own views.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the monthly active users published and past 2,000, plus a month of free stats showing views and saves on my own nights, with the month-to-month cancel actually honoured.
